title: Phobos monolith and the proposed NASA sample mission

tellings.quote:
this uh monolith that NASA has imaged on
Phobos one of the moons of Mars

plain: NASA has imaged a "monolith", a tall block-like feature, on Phobos, one of the moons of Mars, and around 2007 there was talk of a NASA mission to go and sample it. Maaneli Derakhshani, a guest on the show, raises it with Michels without naming a source, bringing in the Apollo astronaut Buzz Aldrin's name alongside it. If the object is what some suggest, it would be something worth sending a spacecraft to touch.
